title: Independently check #4438: within-cell gauge column transfer (C = 3 least, equality at p = 2; no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/gauge-column-check/`. It is an independent check of jwr404's #4438, the within-cell gauge column transfer for `diag(â)Ĝdiag(â)^{−1}`.

**Claim type:** an independent check by separate code, with exact rationals where possible. **No new κ.**

## Results

All of #4438's statements check out.

- **Factorization.** `n_{i,h} = (a_i/a_{i+h})exp(−aρh²)` with `a_i = exp(aβ_i²/θ)`. It holds on 2,000 random constant-phase runs from LOG-A's entry law, with log error ≤ `6·10⁻¹³`.
- **Column bound.** The `1/(1−ε)` bound holds on the random rounded blocks, with maximum ratio 0.99977, so it is nearly tight.
- **Ceiling.** The gap is exactly `1/(16p²−1)` at `ε = 1/(16p²)`, and `ε = 1/2` leaves none.
- **Setup constant.** `C = 3` is the least integer with `2^{−Cp} ≤ 1/(16p²)`. Note that it holds with **equality at `p = 2`**, so there is no slack there.
- **Downstream comparison.** `p(2p−1) > 2` holds.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gauge-column-check --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gauge-column-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/gauge-column-check outcome=completed   (~1 s, stdlib only)
```
